description: Completes the Codex command policy for unattended task closure so evidence recording, closure-status, the archive rename, repository validation, and read-only inspection run without approval prompts.
delta: The managed Codex rules file allows meridian worktree evidence and closure-status, git mv (forced moves keep prompting), the exact repository validation commands, and read-only inspection tools. Write-capable or program-executing forms such as sed -i, rg --pre, find -exec, and mv stay unmatched and keep prompting. Existing prompt and forbidden rules are unchanged.
verification: an adopter project with local rules appended receives the new rules by upgrade --apply and keeps its local rules
codex execpolicy check allows each added command and still prompts for git mv -f and leaves sed -i and rg --pre unmatched
meridian codex doctor reports each new rule group as ready or as a named gap
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests pass
